scope: Only RouterBSIPaper/figs/routerbsi_test_ndcg@1_std and this implementation_report.json were authored. No raw-run writes, sibling writes, model calls, manuscript changes/build, or commits.

implementation.metric: Binary nDCG@1 = integer top-ranked relevance hits / 748, verified nonempty required_ids; empty rankings score zero.
implementation.aggregation: Equally weighted task mean per run, arithmetic mean and population SD across the three run means; ddof=0. Exact integer hits and round-trip full-precision floats retained.
raw_validation: exact unique test membership from test_state.task_ids
stable required_ids, task hashes and tier across all 36 evaluations
saved policy content hash recomputed and matched to library_hash
all candidate_statements match saved initial/accepted/final policies
prediction library hashes match saved policies
numbered policy ledger iteration, before_hash and accepted_hash chain
final policy matches iteration10 and test_state
final prediction bytes duplicate iteration10 in each run
stored MRR@10 recomputed and checked for every evaluation
implementation.style: One green #009E73 RouterBSI mean line, diamond markers, dash-dot line, shaded +/-1 population SD; 218 x 154 PDF points; 8-9pt serif text; all twelve categorical ticks; cold start wrapped and endpoint labels aligned away from adjacent ticks.
implementation.readability_manifest: Replaced copied stale metadata with current target-specific Agg text bounds, fonts, geometry, line coordinates and band vertices; explicitly does not assert composed-TeX measurements or a manuscript figure number.
implementation.scope_guard: CLI writes only beside its script; programmatic test outputs must be descendants of the target figure folder. Outputs staged and source hashes rechecked before publication; manifest published last.

source_caveats: All three runs remain completed_noncanonical, reportable=false; this is analysis-only.
Final duplicates iteration10 and is not an extra training update or independent repeat; explicitly stated in caption and provenance.
All runs use saved seed=20260324 with distinct initial predicate policies/cache files; no claim of three seeds or statistical independence.
Run1 source_manifest_sha256 differs from runs2/3; completion metadata and provenance preserve the difference without claiming equivalent builds.
Missing saved Hit@1 values are explicitly flagged unavailable_not_stored, not imputed or used to drop complete raw-prediction evaluations.
